meta.title: Evolve Scholarship Library
meta.note: Every entry was checked against the sponsor's official page on the review date. Sponsors change rules and dates, so always confirm on the official link before applying. Fields marked 'verify' could not be fully confirmed.

scholarships.name: Cooke College Scholarship Program
scholarships.amount: Up to $55,000 per year (last-dollar)
scholarships.date_note: Applied through the Common App.
scholarships.eligibility: High school senior graduating spring 2027; minimum 3.75 unweighted GPA; family income up to $95,000 (the page uses both 'annual gross' and 'adjusted gross' income, so verify); must submit an SAT, ACT, AP, or IB score (no minimum).
scholarships.requirements: Two teacher recommendations, counselor recommendation, school report, self-reported transcript, test score(s).
scholarships.essays: Not described on the how-to-apply page; check the Common App application.

scholarships.name: Cooke Undergraduate Transfer Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Up to $55,000 per year for 2–3 years (last-dollar)
scholarships.date_note: Application listed as open on the review date.
scholarships.eligibility: Top community college students with financial need who plan to transfer to a four-year college to finish a bachelor's degree. No minimum GPA is listed (recent scholars averaged a 3.94).

scholarships.name: Ron Brown Scholar Program
scholarships.amount: $40,000 ($10,000 a year for 4 years)
scholarships.date_note: Transcripts and recommendation letters due December 15. The site lists both dates, so confirm with the program.
scholarships.eligibility: Black/African American high school seniors who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents, excel academically, show leadership and community service, and demonstrate financial need.
scholarships.essays: Three essays of about 500 words each. Two answer set prompts; the third is any topic (a class or college essay may be reused).

scholarships.name: Dell Scholars Program
scholarships.amount: $20,000 plus laptop, book credits, emergency funds, teletherapy
scholarships.date_note: For the 2027 cycle the official page limits eligibility to Texas students attending Texas public universities.
scholarships.eligibility: Senior graduating from a Texas high school; took part in an approved college readiness program in grades 11 and 12; plans to attend an accredited four-year public university in Texas; Pell Grant eligible; GPA of at least 2.4.
scholarships.essays: Not listed on the students page; check the application.

scholarships.name: Jackie Robinson Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Four-year scholarship (dollar amount not stated on the 2026 flyer)
scholarships.date_note: Flyer says the application opens in September 2026.
scholarships.eligibility: Graduating high school seniors who are U.S. citizens with a record of academic excellence; SAT or ACT scores required.
scholarships.requirements: Application, test scores, college and early career goals.

scholarships.name: Burger King Scholars
scholarships.date_note: Apply at burgerking.scholarsapply.org.
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors in North America, plus Burger King employees and their families. Selection weighs GPA, work experience, activities, financial need, and community service.

scholarships.name: Elks Most Valuable Student Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Top 20 finalists receive $30,000 (other levels: see site)
scholarships.date_note: Due 11:59 p.m. Pacific. Quarter-finalists upload FAFSA Submission Summary and transcript in January.
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors who are U.S. citizens (permanent residents are not eligible). Elks membership not required. No ACT/SAT required.
scholarships.essays: Additional essay at the semi-finalist stage.

scholarships.name: Regeneron Science Talent Search
scholarships.amount: Top award $250,000; $3.1M awarded annually
scholarships.date_note: Due 8 p.m. Eastern.
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors who submit original research. See the Official Rules for full criteria.
scholarships.essays: Multiple short-answer and essay responses (see application).

scholarships.name: Live Your Dream Awards
scholarships.amount: $1,000 – $16,000 (club, region, and international levels)
scholarships.date_note: Official page lists Aug 1 – Nov 15 without a year; verify the current cycle.
scholarships.eligibility: Women who provide the primary financial support for themselves and their dependents, show financial need, and are enrolled in or accepted to a vocational/skills program or undergraduate degree. Not for women who hold or are pursuing a graduate degree.

scholarships.name: Point Foundation Flagship Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Up to $15,000 per year (up to 4 years)
scholarships.date_note: Closes 5 p.m. Pacific. Page lists Sept 9 – Nov 19 without a year; verify.
scholarships.eligibility: Identify as LGBTQ+ or an ally; minimum 3.3 GPA; full-time at an accredited not-for-profit U.S. college (not 100% online); at least a high school senior.

scholarships.name: Point Foundation Community College Scholarship
scholarships.date_note: Page lists Jan 27 – Apr 8 for 2027–28 funding without a year; verify.
scholarships.eligibility: Identify as LGBTQ+ or an ally; minimum 2.5 GPA; at least half-time at an accredited not-for-profit community college; no bachelor's degree.

scholarships.name: Jeannette Rankin National Scholar Grant
scholarships.amount: Up to $3,000 per year, renewable up to 5 years
scholarships.date_note: Application and recommendation letter both due Feb 12. Notification July 31, 2027.
scholarships.eligibility: Women 35 or older with financial need pursuing technical/vocational training, a first associate's degree, or a first bachelor's degree at an accredited nonprofit U.S. school.

scholarships.name: Courage to Grow Scholarship
scholarships.date_note: Deadline shown on the official page on the review date.
scholarships.eligibility: High school juniors, seniors, or college students with at least a 2.5 GPA; U.S. citizens only.

scholarships.name: Texas State Aid Priority Deadline (FAFSA or TASFA)
scholarships.amount: State grants such as the TEXAS Grant — varies
scholarships.date_note: January 15 is a priority (not hard) deadline many Texas colleges use for 2027–28 aid. Filing early improves access to limited funds.
scholarships.eligibility: Texas residents. Students who file the FAFSA should not also file the TASFA; the TASFA is for students who do not complete the FAFSA. Check with the college to confirm the right form.

scholarships.name: Terry Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Full ride, last-dollar, up to 8 semesters
scholarships.date_note: Deadlines are set by each of the 11 Terry-affiliated Texas public universities. Check each university's Terry page.
scholarships.eligibility: Texas high school seniors (no gap year) admitted to a Terry-affiliated public university; U.S. citizen or permanent resident qualifying for in-state tuition; strong academics, financial need (FAFSA), leadership; live on campus first year.
scholarships.requirements: University nomination, then interview with a Terry panel.

scholarships.name: Horatio Alger National Scholarship
scholarships.date_note: Apply in the junior year. Application dates were not posted on the official page on the review date.
scholarships.eligibility: Full-time high school juniors; adjusted gross family income of $100,000 or less; minimum 2.0 GPA; U.S. citizen; perseverance in overcoming adversity; community involvement.
scholarships.requirements: Counselor certification, transcript with fall grades, income verification, support-form provider.
scholarships.essays: Your Horatio Alger story plus short adversity responses.

scholarships.name: HSF Scholar Program
scholarships.date_note: Last cycle opened Jan 5 and closed Feb 15, 2026. Next cycle dates were not posted on the review date.
scholarships.eligibility: Students of Hispanic heritage; U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or DACA recipient; 3.0 GPA (high school) or 2.5 (college/grad); full-time at a four-year or graduate school; FAFSA required.

scholarships.name: The Gates Scholarship
scholarships.amount: Full cost of attendance not covered by other aid (last-dollar)
scholarships.date_note: Closed for this cycle. Current juniors: plan to apply next summer.
scholarships.eligibility: Pell-eligible high school seniors; minimum 3.3 weighted GPA; U.S. citizen or permanent resident; full-time at a four-year not-for-profit college.

scholarships.name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
scholarships.amount: $20,000 (150 scholars)
scholarships.date_note: Closed for the class of 2027. Current juniors: plan for next August.
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors with at least a 3.0 GPA; U.S. citizen, national, permanent resident, refugee, asylee, Cuban-Haitian entrant, or humanitarian parolee.

scholarships.name: QuestBridge National College Match
scholarships.amount: Full four-year scholarship at a partner college (if matched)
scholarships.date_note: Closed. Match Day is Dec 1, 2026; non-matched finalists' Regular Decision form due Dec 10. Juniors: look at QuestBridge College Prep Scholars in spring.
scholarships.eligibility: High-achieving high school seniors from low-income backgrounds (see QuestBridge eligibility).

scholarships.name: Patsy Takemoto Mink Education Support Award
scholarships.amount: Up to $5,000 (5 awards)
scholarships.date_note: 2026–27 cycle closed Aug 1, 2026. 2027–28 information expected May 2027.
scholarships.eligibility: Mothers 17+ with minor children; low family income (2026–27 limits: under $21,640 for 2, $27,320 for 3, $33,000 for 4); full-time; pursuing a higher level than any degree already held (vocational through doctoral).

scholarships.name: NBNA Scholarship Program
scholarships.amount: From $1,000
scholarships.date_note: Last cycle deadline was March 15, 2026. Next cycle dates were not posted on the review date.
scholarships.eligibility: NBNA members (and local chapter members where one exists within 50 miles) enrolled in a nursing program from LPN/LVN through doctorate, in good standing, with at least one full year left.

scholarships.name: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
scholarships.date_note: Last deadline was Feb 18, 2026. Next cycle date not confirmed on the review date.
scholarships.eligibility: Age 18 or younger; U.S. citizen or permanent resident living in the U.S.; significant project in STEM, humanities, or 'Outside the Box'.

scholarships.name: LULAC National Scholarship Fund
scholarships.date_note: Application closed on the review date; next dates not posted. You must live where a participating LULAC council operates.
scholarships.eligibility: U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or DACA recipient applying to or enrolled in college, community college, or vocational school; must live in an area with a participating LULAC council.

scholarships.name: McDonald's HACER National Scholarship
scholarships.amount: $1 million shared by up to 100 students
scholarships.date_note: Closed on the review date; next cycle not posted. Eligibility details are on a separate official page (verify).
scholarships.eligibility: Verify on the official eligibility page. Selection weighs academics, community impact, personal statement, and financial need.
